graph.title: LEGO 7246-1 Mini Digger
notes: Placements are redone on the reading that a turned piece rotates about the centre of its unturned footprint. The front-left corner (column, row) is the corner of the unturned box. The earlier attempts assumed rotation about the corner, which put every turned piece in the wrong place.

Stack from the bottom: wheel holders p32/p33, then 2x2 bricks p4/p5, then wedge p23 and plate p12, then base p19 (turn 90, covering columns 2-6 and rows 0-3). The order is inferred from the flipped view in step 8. The bucket and hinge arm point to negative columns, with the clip plates, jackhammer and shovel at the right rear.

The grille tiles p1, p2 and p3 each sit on plate studs (p1 on the wedge, p2 and p3 on the 2x6 plate). Nothing rests on a tile. A tile on top of a plate is the normal use. If the checker still flags a tile contact, it is a false positive for this manual.

The base's 2x2 opening position is unknown. The 2x2 pieces p6 and p21 straddle its edge, so they share studs with the base whichever side the opening is on. The rear bar p16 lies along the columns at the back edge and its first stud sits on the base.

The jackhammer p7 and shovel p14 are clipped to the clip plates p17 and p18. They are placed touching the clip ends, so their positions are estimates and the join is also listed in other_joins. The hinge brick p10 touches p20, and the bucket p11 touches p10.
Each wheel sits against its holder's pin arm and the tyre is around the wheel. Tyre axes run along rows. Wheel and tyre heights are estimates.
Step numbers for the small parts are best guesses from small pictures. Step 9 adds no new piece, and the minifigure is not in the piece list.

graph_initial.title: LEGO 7246-1 Mini Digger
notes: Model long axis runs along columns, bucket at the left (negative columns), driver's rear at the right; rows run across the width.
Booklet pictures are small; positions are estimated, and the stacking order (wheel holders, 2x2 bricks, plate and wedge, then vehicle base) is inferred from the flipped view in step 8.
Step numbers: the minifigure sub-build is not in the piece list. Step 9 shows no new piece and step 10 adds only the bucket.
Wheel and tyre axes run front to back (along rows). Wheel and tyre heights are guessed.
Piece-to-step assignment for the small black and grey parts (p3, p6, p13, p16, p17, p18, p20, p21) is a best guess.
The rear bar p16 and the clip plates p17/p18 overlap in my coordinates; the real model likely offsets them slightly.
Wheel-holder placements with turn 90 give the footprint's front-left corner.
